description: Implementation of PackageManager class handling package download, install, uninstall, and telemetry within WPEFramework Plugin system.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package management including download, install, uninstall, and telemetry within WPEFramework.

classes.name: DownloadInfo
classes.description: Represents download task details such as URL, ID, retries, rate limit, and file location.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a download or install notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a download or install notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the given service, sets up storage, telemetry, and download thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and releases telemetry and service references.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts downloading a package from a URL with specified options.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package given its ID, version, metadata, and file location, with telemetry reporting.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID, removing storage and updating state with telemetry.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all installed packages.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access, returning lock ID, path, runtime config, and metadata.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases a lock on a package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock status, path, runtime config, and lock count for a package.

methods.name: GetConfigForPackage
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration for a package based on file metadata.

methods.name: downloader
methods.description: Background thread function handling package downloads with retries and status notifications.

methods.name: NotifyDownloadStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about download status updates.

methods.name: NotifyInstallStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about package installation status.
